quantity: Frozen VDA predicted normalized disparity q/255; not metric true depth. Larger values are interpreted as nearer.
encoding: Original grayscale uint8 PNG; q/255 gives normalized disparity. Original filename suffix zf records frozen focus only for frames0–24.
preview: RGB resized linearly; disparity mapped to fixed VIRIDIS range0–1 on native grid then resized nearest to1024x576. H264 MP4 is visualization only; use original PNG for numerical work.
preview_fps_note: Display choice only; not a claim about source capture rate. 80 frames at20fps=4 seconds; use slowdown controls.
focus: Defined only for frames0–24; no focus or ATB predictions generated for25–79.
